body.statement: The estimator in \(\operatorname{def:pca-estimator}\) satisfies \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)}\mathbb E_P L(\widehat\mu,\mu(P))\le K\min\{1,(Ns_N^2)^{-1}\}\), where \(K\) depends only on the fixed primitive radii and \((T,C)\).
body.justification: A finite-sample risk bound is the achievability half needed to distinguish genuine statistical weakness from a fragile proof of consistency.
body.gap: Lei and Ross give fixed-point asymptotic linearity, while Srivastava and Pimentel-Alarcón give a projection perturbation bound; neither supplies the causal mean risk bound uniformly over shrinking shells with cohort moments estimated from the full sample.
body.consumer: The bound supplies a tuning-free error scale for rank-two counterfactual means returned by covariance-PCA implementations.
